text:
Predicates:
PrivateIvyLeagueResearchUniversity(x) ::: x is a private Ivy League research university.
Move(x, y) ::: x moved to y.
Endowment(x, y) ::: x's endowment was valued at y.
Organized(x, y) ::: x is organized into y.
ResidentialCollege(x) ::: x is a residential college.
Premises:
PrivateIvyLeagueResearchUniversity(yale) ::: Yale University is a private Ivy League research university.
Move(yale, newHaven) ∧ year1716 ::: Yale University moved to New Haven in 1716.
Endowment(yale, $42.3billion) ::: Yale university's endowment was valued at $42.3 billion.
Organized(yale, 27) ::: Yale University has been organized into 27 constituent colleges and schools.
ResidentialCollege(benjaminFranklin) ∧ ResidentialCollege(berkeley) ∧ ResidentialCollege(branford) ∧ ResidentialCollege(davenport) ∧ ResidentialCollege(ezraStiles) ∧ ResidentialCollege(graceHopper) ∧ ResidentialCollege(jonathanEdwards) ∧ ResidentialCollege(morse) ∧ ResidentialCollege(pauliMurray) ∧ ResidentialCollege(pierson) ∧ ResidentialCollege(saybrook) ∧ ResidentialCollege(silliman) ∧ ResidentialCollege(timothyDwight) ∧ ResidentialCollege(trumbull) ::: A list of residential colleges at Yale.
Conclusion:
∃x (PrivateIvyLeagueResearchUniversity(x) ∧ Move(x, newHaven)) ::: A private Ivy League research university moved to New Haven.
